newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Building pay rises not sustainable - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Building pay rises not sustainable - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday recent building industry pay rises were inconsistent with low inflation.
"You can't see how a 24 percent outcome over three years would be sustainable," Costello told reporters.

"Nor could you see how an outcome like that would be consistent with a low inflation environment, and therefore not being consistent with that low inflation environment (it) is not contributing to our policy of taking pressure off interest rates," he said.

Costello had been asked about a report in Wednesday's Australian Financial Review that said big building contractors had conceded wage rises of 21 to 24 percent over the next three years due to cost pressures in the construction industry.
The Reserve Bank has warned that wages growth not consistent with low inflation could jeopardise interest rate cuts.
